protocol: MED010 Gate-A: long note vs answer-blind BM25 Top1/Top3 vs wrong-patient note; NO TRAINING
retriever: Deterministic word BM25 on overlapping case-note sentence windows; question-only ranking
limitations: The question cohort has already been examined in MED008/009 and cannot be called an independent test.
The same eight patients were present in earlier training stages; this test isolates record retrieval and reading only.
Exact answer in selected passage is a lower-bound proxy for evidence hit, not clinical entailment.
Wrong patient record may itself contain coincidentally identical numbers; inspect contamination flags.
Do not train on these quarantined QA targets or on model-generated answers without clinical review.
The full record contains answer text; full-note and retrieval are context reading, NOT parametric patient memory.
No clinical expert review has been conducted.
